title: Midphase roadmap traffic sentinel and readiness diary
content:
Objective:
Midphase roadmap + traffic sentinel: provide a concise, operational readiness diary and KPI tracker to guide a staged ramp from 0->25% traffic (pilot->beta) and then to 100% across Dedicated/Hosted variants. Focus on safety gates, staffing, and quick rollback playbook.

Status: draft notes and experiments. This is a working sheet (not release doc).

High-level ramp plan (phases):
- Phase A (pilot, 0->1%): smoke tests, internal beta, sticky customers only, 48h observation window
- Phase B (pilot expansion, 1->5%): external beta cohorts, canary routing across two regions, 72h observation window
- Phase C (ramp, 5->25%): capacity commit to Dedicated pool, staggered traffic pulses (12h cadence), canary rollback enabled
- Phase D (scale to 100%): final SLA checks, cost run-rate verification, gradual HB/AB traffic split to measure user-impact

Core KPIs to monitor (live dashboard inputs):
- Request success rate (goal >= 99.5%) — metric name: serving.request_success_pct
- Error rate (5xx) — threshold warn: 0.8%; critical: 1.5%
- Latency p95 (ms) — warn: >750ms; critical: >1200ms
- Token cost per 1M tokens — target: <$18 / 1M tokens for hosted defaults; watch for Dedicated delta
- Throughput per-GPU (tokens/s) — baseline by model variant (see model-catalog sheet)
- Cache hit rate (prefix/KV) — aim >= 65% for chat workloads to preserve latency
- Quality regression (evaluation set A/B) — no >3% drop in rouge/semantic-similarity vs baseline

Traffic Sentinel heuristics (rolling detectors):
- Short-window spike detector (5m): trigger paging if error rate delta > 0.5% and throughput drop > 10% vs baseline
- Degradation trend (1h): if p95 increases >20% for 3 consecutive 10m buckets, elevate to oncall P1
- Cost drift monitor (24h): if cost per token increases >30% vs predicted ramp model, signal finance + infra

Gating rules for phase transitions (must verify all):
- Perf gate: p95 within warn threshold for full 72h of phase window
- Reliability gate: 5xx < warn threshold for 72h and no single-severity incident >15m
- Quality gate: automated eval suite passes; human-sample review (10 sessions) shows no hallucination spikes
- Ops gate: oncall + SRE staffing confirmed for 72h after transition (rota in calendar)

Oncall / staffing plan (micro-rotations):
- Primary: prod-ops lead (Maya) 09:00-21:00 PST during ramp days
- Secondary: SRE (Liam) 24/7 on standby pager for P1s
- Model/ML contact: Priya for quality regressions during business hours
- Escalation: Diego -> Head of Product Ops -> CTO (per incident SOP)
- Small-team overlap windows: 08:30-09:30 and 20:30-21:30 for handoffs (record in rota)

Readiness checklist (pre-phase-B):
- [ ] Canary image pinned to model:v2025-11-01
- [ ] Load test results attached to linked_artifacts (baseline and 2x surge)
- [ ] Rollback playbook annotated with exact route IDs and traffic-shift scripts
- [ ] Ownership matrix (oncall, rollback owner, customer comms owner)
- [ ] Eval harness pass (unit prompts + stress prompts, perf and quality)

Quick rollback playbook (summary):
1) Detect via sentinel -> confirm incident via traces (trace id + sample request)
2) Move 100% traffic to safe variant (model-stable-v2025-09), or route to Hosted fallback cluster
3) Reclaim prefix cache warmup schedule (priority warmup for top 100 prefixes)
4) Notify customers via status page draft (owner: Diego) and Slack #incidents
5) Postmortem owner assigned within 24h

Diary / recent runs (short log):
- 2025-11-05: smoke run A (internal): CPU-bound latency tail observed on long-turn dialogues; cache hit = 52% -> note: tweak prefix TTL and increase cache warmers
- 2025-11-19: synthetic 10k rps soak for 30m: p95 spiked to 1100ms at minute 18; root cause suspected GPU kernel degrade on sequence length >1k; mitigation: fallback to quantized kernel during sequences >900 tokens
- 2025-12-11: canary beta 1% — success, error rate 0.3%, p95 620ms, but cost per 1M tokens +22% vs estimate; action: infra to run batching adjustment (Liam) and product to triage prompt length (Priya)
- 2026-01-20: midphase rehearsal — oncall overlap missed (handoff not recorded) -> updated rota and added mandatory handoff checklist

Open questions / TODOs (triage):
- Q: exact guardrail values for multivariate models (chat+tooling) — do we set stricter latency or quality thresholds? (action: product ops to propose by 2026-03-05)
- Q: who owns customer comms for slow-roll; need standard template (action: Diego)
- TODO: add per-region capacity map and live GPU utilization sheet (blocked by infra: capacity-alloc JIRA)
- TODO: finalize Dedicated commit delta cost model (finance review by 2026-03-10)

Metrics snapshot example (copy into dashboard):
Time window: last 24h
- requests: 1,283,412
- success_pct: 99.62
- 5xx_count: 4,793
- p95_ms: 648
- cache_hit_pct: 58
- cost_per_1M_tokens: $21.40

Communication & stakeholder plan:
- Daily ramp standup (15m) 09:15 PST (product-ops, SRE, infra, ML)
- Twice-daily incident digest during Phase C (12:00 and 20:00 PST) to execs
- Weekly cadence memo (Friday EOD) summarizing KPIs & decisions (owner: Maya)

Notes to self: keep this doc minimal — link to the larger runbook for run commands. Use this diary for quick situational awareness during ramp windows.

Relevant links (paste to ticket before each phase):
- Runbook (prodops-runbook): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/ProdOps+Runbook
- Load tests artifacts: s3://redwood-loadtests/midphase/2025-11
- Rollback scripts repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/traffic-shift-scripts

End of entry.
